evidence: The as-grown films deposited with H plasma showed a resistivity of ~395 µΩ -cm, which is higher than the bulk resistivity of W-metal. However, the β-W is supposed to possess much higher resistivity (~100 – 300 µΩ -cm) compared to the most stable α-phase of the metal-W (5.6 µΩ -cm). Therefore, the relatively higher resistivity for the ALD-W obtained in the current study is in good agreement with the obtained crystalline phase in the present study.
